source_text: Μετὰ τὴν μνηστείαν συνέλαβεν, ἵνα δόξῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ κεκυηκέναι καὶ ἵνα ἐξ αὐτοῦ γενεαλογηθῇ καὶ σχῇ καὶ κηδεμόνα ἐν ταῖς ἐπιβουλαῖς.
pass_a_gloss: After the betrothal she conceived, in order that she might seem out of him to have been pregnant and in order that out of him she might be genealogized and might have also a guardian in the plots.
pass_b_english: She conceived after the betrothal so she would seem to have carried a child by Joseph, so the genealogy could run through him, and so she would have a guardian when plots rose against them.
